# Codemerce Intro V2 — Intro Only

This is ONLY the intro overlay. It does not create or replace your symposium application.

Flow:
1. Saranathan College logo reveal.
2. Saranathan College of Engineering title.
3. A cinematic red beam shoots across.
4. The beam forms a red circular portal transition.
5. A SEPARATE Codemerce screen appears.
6. Codemerce SYMBOL appears first.
7. Codemerce WORDMARK appears underneath.
8. The intro fades away and your existing website becomes visible.

The intro fires:
window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("codemerceIntroFinished"));

Assets:
- college-logo.jpg
- codemerce-symbol.png
- codemerce-wordmark.png

Put this intro as an overlay above your existing application.
